verdict.rationale: FreeAgent documents in-product smart features that act on the user's own data. Smart categorisation automatically explains new transactions based on previous descriptions, Smart Capture automatically extracts, matches and categorises receipts, and the dashboard shows a 90-day cashflow projection. None of these is described as AI-generated, and none is a general insight or suggestion engine. Missing for 10: explicit AI or LLM-generated insights or recommendations, natural-language analysis of financial data, any documentation of how suggestions are generated, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Save time with smart categorisation which automatically explains new transactions based on previous descriptions.
Smart Capture tool, which offers automatic data extraction, transaction matching and categorisation for receipt and bill images and files.
Track cashflow in real time on your dashboard and see your 90-day projection.
